**Agent review** of the whole pull request, at `1fdeba7`: all 7 files reviewed.

6 finding(s), 2 to fix; 3 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Outside the diff

- **Should fix (correctness): Deleting the only scripts/ test breaks `check-workflows`** (`scripts/claude-review.test.ts`): This was the only `*.test.ts` under `scripts/`. `package.json:42` still runs `bun test ./scripts/` as part of `check-workflows`. Bun exits with code 1 when it finds no test files, so `bun run check-workflows` and the CI job that runs it will probably fail. I did not run it. Drop `&& bun test ./scripts/` from the script, or keep a test there.

- **Note (adr): Consequences still describe the removed local script copy** (`apps/documentation/src/content/docs/architecture/decisions/0028-advisory-claude-review-on-pull-requests.mdx:68`): Lines 68-69 say the script is a copy of the kit's, that fixes must be copied here, and that `bun test ./scripts/` runs its tests. This PR deletes `scripts/claude-review.ts` and its tests, so the text is now false. Line 21 ("a script and a workflow") and the frontmatter description on line 3, which mentions `claude -p` and `pr-review-engine`, also still describe the old setup. An ADR is append-only. The PR rewrites the Status row and decision item 7 in place. A new ADR that supersedes or amends 0028, or a dated history note, would record the move to `niway-dev/agent-review` without rewriting the original decision. The new Status text also says "not yet run in this repository" while it describes a different mechanism.

- **Should fix (correctness): Deleting the last test file breaks `check-workflows`** (`scripts/claude-review.test.ts:1`): This was the only test file under `scripts/`. `package.json:42` still runs `bun test ./scripts/` as the last step of `check-workflows`. With no test files, `bun test` prints "No tests found" and exits 1. The script then fails wherever it runs, locally and in CI. Either drop `bun test ./scripts/` from `check-workflows`, or keep a test file there. I did not check how CI calls `check-workflows`.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 2.** I found nothing in this part that I'd call a bug, and I'd merge it once the two notes are looked at. The PR replaces the in-repo review kit with a short caller of `niway-dev/agent-review@v1`. The `.github/agent-review.md` addition correctly names the ADR directory, which replaces the old `CLAUDE_REVIEW_ADR_DIR` setting. Both notes are about the new workflow caller. The first is that `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` now goes to a reusable workflow on a movable tag, where the old one checked the Claude binary against a SHA-256. The second is that the old workflow's guards for Dependabot, `release-please` branches and per-pull-request concurrency now depend on `review.yml@v1`. I could not see that file, so I couldn't confirm those guards survive. Nothing else in the repository references the deleted `claude-review` files. The deleted test file and the documentation edits belong to the other part.

**Batch 2 of 2.** Part 2 has one probable CI break and one doc problem. Deleting the only `scripts/` test probably makes `bun test ./scripts/` in `check-workflows` fail, because Bun exits 1 when it finds no tests. ADR 0028 was edited in place and its Consequences section still describes the deleted script copy. I did not run `check-workflows`.

**Batch 2 of 2, retry.** Part 2 has one correctness problem and two ADR notes. Deleting the only test under `scripts/` leaves `bun test ./scripts/` in `check-workflows` with no tests, which should exit 1. ADR 0028 also still says the repo carries the script and runs its tests, and its decision text was edited in place despite the append-only rule.
